novelty_basis: Elementary combinatorial game theory - a game in which every play has the same length is decided by parity.
proof_check: written proof (proofs/paper/C04.md Theorem 9, induction on D); the instance ab -> ba is Lean-verified (p_positions); checked on all 102 RD rules and all words of length <= 10
statement: If a one-rule system has random descent, the Sprague-Grundy value of its rewriting game at w is D(w) mod 2, D(w) the common length of all maximal derivations from w; the P-positions are the words with even D(w).
title: Rewriting games of random-descent rules are parity games (Grundy value = D(w) mod 2)
